activeQuestion.prompt: What will the speakers keep in the schedule?

options.text: Keep the live morning presentation, and replace the line tour with slides.
options.zh: 保留上午現場簡報，用投影片取代產線參觀。
options.whyZh: 客戶指定看產線，保留的是參觀；提前寄送的是簡報投影片。

options.text: Keep only the slides in the visit agenda and drop the in-person tour.
options.zh: 參訪行程只保留投影片，取消實地參觀。
options.whyZh: 他們要保留產線實地參觀，不是只提供投影片。

options.text: Keep the assembly-line tour and send the presentation slides ahead of the visit.
options.zh: 保留產線參觀，並在參訪前寄出簡報投影片。
options.whyZh: 客戶特別想看產線，所以保留參觀；原本要做的簡報則改為事先寄送投影片。

options.text: Keep the assembly-line tour but hold the question session before lunch.
options.zh: 保留產線參觀，但把問答排在午餐前。
options.whyZh: 保留產線參觀沒錯，但問答移到午餐後，不是午餐前。

activeQuestion.explanationZh: 客戶特別想看產線，所以保留參觀；原本要做的簡報則改為事先寄送投影片。

group.title: A client visit agenda
group.passage:
Man: The client's flight now arrives at ten instead of eight. We will not have time for both the factory tour and the morning presentation.
Woman: The client asked specifically to see the assembly line. Let us keep the tour and send the presentation slides in advance.
Man: All right. I will move the question session to after lunch. Can you update the visitor badges?
Woman: Yes. Please send me the final list of names before three today.
group.passageZh:
男：客戶班機現在改為十點抵達，而不是八點。我們來不及同時安排工廠導覽和上午簡報。
女：客戶特別要求看組裝線。我們保留導覽，並提前寄出簡報。
男：好。我會把問答時段改到午餐後。你可以更新訪客證嗎？
女：可以。請在今天三點前寄給我最終名單。
